title: The Siren Song of LLMs: How Users Perceive and Respond to Dark Patterns in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Scenario-based user study where participants evaluated LLM responses that exhibited ideological steering by giving politically slanted answers about an election.
Scenario-based user study where participants evaluated LLM responses that exhibited brand favoritism by embedding unsolicited commercial product recommendations.
Scenario-based user study where participants evaluated LLM responses that exhibited sycophantic agreement by uncritically endorsing a user's risky decision or opinions regardless of factual accuracy.
